eventMetadata.context_description: Forecast models from agencies including the Israel Meteorological Service and global ensembles show Tel Aviv maximum temperatures on June 18 clustering tightly around 28–30 °C under persistent high pressure and moderate westerly flow. The narrow spread between 29 °C and 30 °C outcomes reflects minor differences in predicted sea-breeze onset timing and boundary-layer mixing along the coastal plain, with stronger afternoon onshore winds favoring the lower end of the range while lighter winds and greater insolation support the higher. Climatological baselines for mid-June place typical maxima near 29 °C, and current guidance indicates limited potential for significant deviation absent unexpected shifts in low-level moisture or cloud cover. Updated model runs through the evening of June 17 will provide the final refinement before observations begin.
